_source: The native registry of the LuV C3 bench run luv-c3-s1 (2026-10-26, kubejs-exported/items.json, format gg-items-1): every item, block item and fluid id that LuV B7 (startup_scripts/grindless/luv/io_orbit.js, server_scripts/grindless/luv/io_orbit.js and the bench fixture gg_test_luv_io_orbit.js) uses, each one checked to be in that registry, A1's registrations included. gtceu:luv_dynamo_hatch and gtceu:quadruple_output_hatch are NOT in it (the LuV dynamo is gtceu:luv_energy_output_hatch).
_how_it_is_used: tools/analysis/test/luv-io-orbit.test.mjs checks every id the two scripts and the fixture use, in recipes, patterns and placements, against this list. Never add an id that is not in a native registry export.
